AI project · 5th-semester mini project

CareerMatch AI

Smarter resume screening. Better career opportunities.

An AI-based resume screening and job recommendation system for college placements. It connects students, placement cells, recruiters and administrators, and explains every match it makes.

How it works

  1. A student uploads a resume (PDF or DOCX) and the text is extracted.
  2. NLP cleans the text: tokenization, lemmatization and stop-word removal.
  3. Skills are pulled out across six domains using dictionary and pattern matching.
  4. Job descriptions are processed the same way.
  5. Sentence Transformers (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) turn both into embeddings, compared with cosine similarity.
  6. Students who miss the hard criteria (CGPA, backlogs, branch) are filtered out.
  7. A hybrid multi-factor score ranks the remaining matches.
  8. Each match shows why it fits, plus a skill-gap roadmap of what to learn next.

Who uses it

Students
See extracted resume details, a resume quality score (0–100), ranked jobs and skill gaps, then apply.
Placement officers
Screen students against a drive, inspect match explanations and export shortlists.
Recruiters
Post jobs with required and preferred skills and shortlist from ranked candidates.
Administrators
Manage the skill taxonomy and audit logs, and tune the matching weights.

Built with

Frontend
React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Vite
Backend
Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.0
Database
PostgreSQL 16 (18 tables), with a SQLite fallback for offline work
AI and NLP
scikit-learn, Sentence Transformers, spaCy
Security
JWT, BCrypt, role-based access control

Progress

Planned in 12 phases, from architecture and authentication through the matching engine and dashboards to testing and final polish. Phase 1 is complete.
